stance: Policy stance is hawkish-leaning. The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on 2026-10-28 with a 10-2 vote, both dissenters (Cook, Hammack) favouring a 25bp hike. The ECB held at 2.50% on 2026-10-29 as expected; tone and vote unconfirmed. September HICP at 3.75% yoy, above the 3.6% expected, keeps a December ECB hike in play (64 of 73 in the Reuters poll). Softer inflation or lower energy prices would ease the view; a hike signal from the ECB would harden it.
